Little Clicks — original Spider card deck, October 2026

Six original court portraits generated with OpenAI's built-in image generation
tool. Hearts use crimson and gold; spades use cobalt, turquoise and gold.
Each portrait is mirrored by code for an exact 180-degree counterpart.

Card frames, corner marks, pip layouts, shaded suit shapes and red web backs
are constructed as SVG. Rank outlines are rendered from Times New Roman;
no font software is distributed. Court illustrations are high-resolution
embedded images; the frames, ranks and pips remain vectors at every size.

The visual reference was the Modern deck at free-spider-solitaire.com,
published by TreeCardGames. That site states "All rights reserved."
Its card images, code and backgrounds are not included in this deck.
The new art is original, not licensed from or endorsed by TreeCardGames.

Source artwork and generation prompts are retained in the project repository
under asset-sources/courts. build-spider-cards.mjs builds the 26 faces.
